author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws - Anime / manga style illustrations - Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration - Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork - Semi-realistic illustrations - and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

author: Kat
title: Paid human illustrator for short stories
content: Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work. NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art. I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don’t need full cover designs for every individual story. What I am looking for is a small black-and-white illustration for each story that gives “Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark”. Ideally an artist who can gently teach me how much they should be paid for each illustration. I have most of one short done now, have 12 total planned. Artist would get credit as the artist/illustrator. Contact via DM on this post.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with because I know the bots are about to find me. See the next posts for more details on what I’m looking for with each!

author: colli.ns258
title: Urgent original artwork for personal project
content: URGENTLY LOOKING FOR ARTIST. Need some original artwork done for a personal project. Looking for a creative person who can follow references but still add their own touch. Good communication is important. Budget: £70–£115. Beginners with decent samples can apply too.
